title: Fabulous Guide
text: t our guide, Simon, was outstanding.  Knew the garden detail and told wonderful stories about the Alhambra.  No line, direct through at every entrance.  Could not have been better.  Disappointed in the driver, but he did get us for Motrin to Granda and back but he skipped the short tour promised in Granda.
author: Taylor_M

title: The tour guide was...
text: The tour guide was excellent . So accommodating and patient . We have some elderly friends travelled with us . The tour guide is very considerate and go with our pace.
author: Sandia_L
